Entries.Text: Could not read the vanilla MSB of {0}, so it is not compared with vanilla.

Colours the objects in Map Contents that differ from the vanilla map (modified) or that the vanilla map doesn't have (added). Objects are matched by list and name, so a renamed object counts as added. The colours can be changed in the theme.
{0} has no vanilla MSB (the project added it), so there is nothing to compare with.
The vanilla map has no object of this type with this name: it was added (or renamed).
Sets every field listed below back to its vanilla value, as one step that can be undone. The name stays, as objects are matched by name.
Sets {0} back to its vanilla value. Can be undone.
Lists what the active map changes from the vanilla map: objects modified, objects added, and vanilla objects no longer in it, which can be restored.
Load a map, or select an object in one, to compare it.
Compare the active map with its vanilla MSB.
Parts, regions and events, matched with vanilla by list and name. Lights and the other map files are not compared.
The compared map has been unloaded. Compare again.
The map has been edited since this comparison. Compare again to update it.
Selects and frames the object. Properties > Compare with Vanilla lists what changed.
The object is gone since the comparison. Compare again.
Puts the vanilla object back in the map, as it is in vanilla. Can be undone.
"{0}" was not restored: {1} already has an object of that type with that name.
